同批派发：objectstack-ai/objectstack#36193、objectstack-ai/objectstack#36194。本卡是缺陷，和 #36194 有衔接（卡上「要做的」第 2 项），可以先做本卡。

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T22:40Z · #36195, folded with #36194 into one PR (list footer calculations follow the view's write rule and join the list draft; maintainer dispatch 22:34Z).
Area: b1-L (epic #35547)
Session: `session_01L6bhgX7ez5A7JDsmzTy9Ks` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-8r2qm4 (from main fa304140)
File surface: `ObjectView.tsx` footer `pickSummary` path, `listDraftStore` (a `summaries` member layered onto the columns at render), the Save paths (`buildPersonalViewConfig`, #36123's `layListStateOverView` once merged), the view-save refusal toast, i18n keys in every locale, tests, docs, changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): new i18n keys (per #36026's precedent).
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, file `build-seat1/36194-36195/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds.
Scope, the seat's reading:
- #36194: choosing, changing or removing a footer calculation applies at once and writes nothing; it joins the #35955 draft (「放弃」 / 「保存」, one line in the unsaved-changes list); 「保存到这个视图」 and 「另存为我的视图」 carry it.
- #36195: "can change in place" reuses the one existing reading (`isAdmin && !activeViewPackageRefusesSaves && isSavedViewId`, the same as #36123's `canSaveToSharedView`), no second rule. On a view that refuses in-place saves, a calculation enters the draft and 「保存」 offers only 「另存为我的视图」.
- Found in the premise: that reading lets HotCRM's package-shipped 「全部客户」 through (it fails open when the package read is missing). The thread finds which case it is; a client-side cause is fixed here, and the same fix stops #36123 offering 「保存到这个视图」 there. If the server's package list reports the view as writable, the thread reports to the seat before changing anything.
- A refused view save (`NOT_OVERRIDABLE` and other 403s) shows the card's Chinese explanation, with the raw text only in the console; field-level validation issues are still listed.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: folded: same footer, same draft store, same Save menu. Overlap on `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` / `ObjectView.tsx` with #36123, #36133, #36128; merge main after #36123 lands. L1 at L1-b; the seat runs the declaration L2. The PR carries `Fixes #36195` and `Fixes #36194`.
